content: Flutter RTL: use Directionality widget + EdgeInsetsDirectional/AlignmentDirectional instead of hardcoded left/right for auto-mirroring. google_fonts package (v8.2.0, published 8 days ago) provides all fonts.google.com fonts including Arabic Naskh-style Amiri, Reem Kufi (Kufic), and Scheherazade New (traditional Arabic calligraphic) -- suitable for Islamic app titles/headers.
